title: רבינא בר שילא

paragraphs: Ravina bar Sheila, Rav Mattana's pupil. I have not found him speaking in R' Mattana's name; Rabbah bar Sheila, however, spoke in R' Mattana's name, and perhaps they are one. But Rabbah bar Sheila spoke in Rav Hisda's name in several places (see there), whereas here it is the reverse: Rav Hisda said that Ravina bar Sheila said, two statements, Sukkah 13a; also Yevamot 68b; Mo'ed Katan 17b, 19b; Zevahim 89b gives a separate teaching in Ravina bar Sheila’s own name. There, 36b: Rav Hisda said that Ravina bar Salla said—a scribal error.
